brief:
Israeli government officials have pushed for the depopulation of Gaza, moving rhetoric toward concrete policy proposals, according to Al Jazeera English. The statements represent a significant shift from earlier public commentary to formal policy consideration by multiple ministers within the government, marking an escalation in official discourse surrounding the territory.

The proposals have emerged alongside accelerated demolitions across the West Bank and mounting Palestinian deaths in Gaza. What was previously confined to political slogans and statements by individual figures has now evolved into structured policy proposals being advanced through government channels. The timing underscores the parallel pressures on Palestinians across occupied territories as military operations continue.
dek: Ethnic cleansing plans move from slogans to policy proposals, amid West Bank demolitions and mounting deaths in Gaza.
title: Israeli ministers propose mass displacement of Gaza population
